notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-A is shorthand for four simultaneous operations: -sV (version), -O (OS detection), --traceroute, -sC (default scripts). Comprehensive single-command enumeration — surfaces service versions, OS, network path, and script output in one run.

=== OUTPUT VALUE ===
In one scan against port 80: Apache version, WordPress version, page title, probable OS, common paths. Against SMTP: OS distribution in banner + EHLO capability list. -A is comprehensive but loud — significantly more traffic and service interaction than individual flags.

=== WHEN TO USE ===
Post-initial-discovery when targeting specific confirmed open ports. Avoid -A in full port range scans — combine -p- (discovery) then targeted -A on found ports.

=== DETECTION ===
-A generates high volumes of diverse probe types. IDS signatures for Nmap -A scans are widely deployed. In sensitive environments, use individual flags instead.
